'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's Drazin Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on his fan site [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="drazin">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/ErikDark.html Feldman's Drazin Deck: Decipher Con Team Play Winning Deck], Paul Todd Feldman, Torch Industries. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303173004/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/ErikDark.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Event:''' [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st (team)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor CCT Feldman DS DecipherCon 1999 Team.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman titled it his "Decipher Con Team Play Winning Deck". He built it to be interactive: it "goes everywhere and fights". [[Corporal Drazin]] retrieves key cards late in the game. The deck starts [[There Is No Try]] against ground decks, [[Security Precautions]] against Hidden Base and [[Battle Order]] against Operatives. He listed its weakness as Sense/Alter Mains and Toys and Oola.

The deck uses [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] cards (released June 1999) and no [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] cards (July 2000). Torch Industries first shows it on 3 March 2000, so the DecipherCon team event it won is the one at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999), in [[Premiere - Endor]].
